reading.rule: pre-specified rule of the ensemble score scaling (fixed scale 1)
reading.criterion_a: Bond-AUROC, median of the per-study differences >= +0.01 and positive in >= 13 of 19 studies, at the N and at the C terminus
reading.criterion_b: Length-matched AUC and Near-miss AUC of the both_bonds score, median of the per-study differences > 0 and positive in >= 13 of 19 studies, each
